author: Susmita Rijal, hiring
text:
We are looking for #ML/ Platform Engineer — Audio AI, GPU Inference and Product for the reputed Dubai based Company (Remote work). Know who might be interested?

Summary
-We are looking for motivated ML and platform engineers who want to learn quickly, take real ownership, and build excellent products from idea to production.
-The founder of this company is from Germany, studied at TUM and Oxford, and now run an AI software lab. We’re a team of 15 building end-to-end tools for professional music producers—from developing and fine-tuning audio models to production infrastructure and polished user interfaces.

Responsibilities
-Start with an idea for a new professional audio tool
-Research relevant papers, models, and existing implementations
-Build, adapt, or fine-tune the model
-Create a reliable production API and inference pipeline
-Optimize GPU infrastructure for speed and cost
-Build interface prototypes using tools such as Claude
-Ship the product, listen to users, and keep improving it
-You would become an *Idea-to-Product Owner*

Requirements
-Platform Engineering (Language: TypeScript)
-Runtime: Node.js
-Framework: Fastify
-Database: PostgreSQL on Google Cloud SQL
-Hosting: Google Cloud Run
-Validation/contracts: Zod with OpenAPI-compatible schemas)
-ML Enginerring (Python, Runpod Serverless, Vast.ai)
-Experience with AI/Agentic Coding

About Us
-We strongly support AI-assisted development. Everyone receives access to capable models, but we believe these tools amplify the engineer behind them. Good judgment, efficient architecture, and a deep understanding of the system still matter enormously.
-A large part of our development team is based in Kathmandu. I’ve visited Nepal more than five times and hope to return soon. I’m open to different backgrounds and levels of specialization—curiosity, ownership, and the desire to push what is possible matter more than having the perfect résumé.
-This is a high-ownership environment with ambitious goals and occasional intense sprints. In return, you’ll have the freedom and tools to take meaningful products from an idea to real users.
